I replied in #coastal-team, in the thread on Bettina's message.

I didn't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest. Scheduled jobs created from this session run locally, and their output isn't posted back to Slack, so nothing would appear in the channel. I told Bettina that I can post the digest on request in the channel, covering the previous week and open customer items, and that a true weekly schedule needs setup on a Slack-connected Hermes gateway by someone with admin access.
